traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb Pandanales page (read 2026-10-16): Pandanaceae spirally three-ranked, Velloziaceae mostly three-ranked, Cyclanthaceae spirally two-ranked, Stemonaceae two-ranked, spiral or opposite. Pandanaceae (about 1,000 of 1,345 spp.) set 'usually'.

traits.life_span.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): woody trees and climbers, perennial herbs, resurrection plants and perennial mycoheterotrophs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): screw pines, Cyclanthaceae and Velloziaceae (resurrection plants keep dried leaves) are evergreen; Triuridaceae have only scales.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): Pandanaceae inflorescence terminal; Velloziaceae terminal though often looking axillary; Stemonaceae and Cyclanthaceae (Carludovicioideae) axillary.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): flowers radial where stated; monosymmetry only in Kupea, Croomia heterosepala and some Cyclanthaceae staminate flowers.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): no floral cup described for any family.
